Hi Dana,

Your workspace is using 100% of the fast-search capacity included in your plan.

Short version: nothing is lost or deleted. Everything you've saved stays searchable. What changes is how quickly some older items come back.

Add capacity

Why it works this way

Tortoise keeps your data in a Postgres database. That's inexpensive, so we can store everything you give us without charging you for it twice.

On top of that we run a graph database. It mirrors a slice of your data and makes search faster and better at following connections — finding things by meaning, and tracing how they relate to each other.

That graph is expensive to run, so we reserve it for what matters most: your highest-value and most frequently searched items. Everything else stays in Postgres.

What you'll notice

Search keeps working across everything. Items outside the fast layer are fetched when you search for them, so they can take a moment longer.

If you want everything in the fast layer, you can add capacity at any time.
